## Internal check

- [ ] Does the repo About description say: "PhAST: A matrix-free, differentiable PyTorch solver for phase-field fracture."?
- [ ] Is the homepage set to `https://cems-lab.github.io/PhAST/`?
- [ ] Are topics up to date (including phase-field-fracture, pytorch, differentiable-simulation, fracture-mechanics, computational-mechanics)?

## External backlinks

- [ ] CEMS Lab / PI / co-author pages link to:
  - `https://cems-lab.github.io/PhAST/`
  - `https://github.com/CEMS-Lab/PhAST`
- [ ] arXiv paper/comments includes both canonical URLs.
- [ ] Zenodo DOI record points to GitHub and documentation URLs.
- [ ] ResearchGate project exists/updated with canonical links.
- [ ] PyTorch Ecosystem submission created or in progress.

## Indexing and discovery checks

- [ ] Social launch post published (X/LinkedIn) with one media visual and tracking link.
- [ ] `sitemap.xml` generated in docs build artifacts and contains PhAST canonical host entries.
- [ ] Google Search Console has sitemap URL submitted and no crawl errors for `cems-lab.github.io/PhAST/`.
- [ ] High-value backlinks requested from at least two university/lab pages.

## Evidence

- Add links to the merged PRs and PR/issue comments showing completion.
- Attach screenshots of external pages (if any) showing the canonical links.
